recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑表面有多核蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）位於吸收凹陷（Howship lacunae）內，並向骨小樑內部挖出通道（tunneling／dissecting resorption），周圍骨髓腔被纖維性基質取代；這是慢性腎病繼發性副甲狀腺亢進（腎性骨失養症）的特徵。
features: Bony trabeculae with irregular scalloped surfaces
Multiple multinucleated osteoclasts sitting in Howship lacunae along trabecular surfaces
Resorption tunneling into the center of trabeculae (dissecting osteitis)
Loose peritrabecular fibrous stroma replacing hematopoietic marrow
Hematopoietic elements scant in this field
describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts occupying Howship lacunae, with resorption cavities tunneling into the trabecular bone. The adjacent marrow space is replaced by loose peritrabecular fibrous stroma, and hematopoietic cells are sparse. Findings are consistent with increased osteoclastic bone resorption (osteitis fibrosa) of secondary hyperparathyroidism/renal osteodystrophy, which can contribute to cytopenias through marrow fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Paget disease has osteoclasts with very numerous nuclei and a mosaic cement-line pattern, without the CKD/PTH context and peritrabecular fibrosis.
PMF shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis within the marrow rather than osteoclast-driven peritrabecular fibrosis.
Tumor-associated osteolysis shows neoplastic cells in the marrow space adjacent to resorbing osteoclasts.
